ig_caption:
One agent is a worker. An orchestrator is the manager 👩‍💼

When one agent has too many jobs (too many tools, rules, context) it starts making mistakes.
So you split the work: research agent, coding agent, review agent. Each gets only the tools and skills it needs.

The orchestrator reads the request, picks the right agent, passes the context and checks the result before it reaches you.

On the platform I build at work, every workspace is wired this way.

Part 6/6 of Agent Harness 101 ✅ Ask me anything in the comments, I answer every one.
